headline: Strategic Fronts Stir Across Central Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger shows fresh movement on several contested fronts. Stlican Shelf has risen from 28 to 32 base events in 24 hours, including four in the latest two-hour window; its nine strategic bases remain split five Warden to four Colonial. Stonecradle, still divided four to five, has likewise recorded five recent events and 28 across the day. Weathered Expanse remains a furious nine-base contest, with four events in two hours and 29 in 24, while casualties and enlistments are accelerating. Godcrofts retains the day’s heaviest recorded turnover at 72 events, but its latest activity was earlier and all nine bases remain Colonial-held. Fisherman’s Row is quieter at the moment, though its 39 daily events—chiefly around Arcadia and Eidolo—mark it as an unsettled sector. Deadlands has newly entered the dispatch with three events, all at Callahan’s Gate, including a recent Warden capture sequence; its casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating sharply. Other fronts show heavy fighting without recorded base turnover in the latest intervals.
